name: swissdial
origin: SwissDial: parallel spoken Swiss German in 8 dialects (AG, BE, BS, GR, LU, SG, VS, ZH) with High German transcripts, ~3 h audio per dialect, 26 h total; Grisons ~3x over-represented
notes: Text side only is needed here. Swiss German has no standard spelling, so the checkable ground truth is the Standard German side. One content, eight dialect 'formats' = natural view pairs.
